points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 钦努阿·阿契贝在尼日利亚乌木乌出生并长大。他的童年和青少年时期在乌木乌度过，这段经历对他后来的文学创作产生了深远的影响。他在这里接受了传统教育，并开始对尼日利亚的文化和历史产生了浓厚的兴趣。
points.descriptionEn: Chinua Achebe was born and raised in Umuofia, Nigeria. His childhood and adolescence were spent in this community, which had a profound impact on his later literary works. He received traditional education here and began to develop a keen interest in Nigerian culture and history.

points.title: 学术与文学起步
points.description: 阿契贝在恩苏卡完成了他的大学教育，并开始写作。他在尼日利亚大学学习英语文学，并在此期间开始创作他的第一部小说《 Things Fall Apart》。这部作品后来成为尼日利亚文学的经典之作，并为他赢得了国际声誉。
points.descriptionEn: Achebe completed his university education in Enugu, Nigeria, and began to write. He studied English literature at the University of Nigeria and started writing his first novel, 'Things Fall Apart,' during this time. This work later became a classic of Nigerian literature and earned him international acclaim.

points.title: 学术生涯
points.description: 阿契贝在英国伦敦的伦敦大学学院完成了他的研究生学习，并在此期间继续他的文学创作。他在伦敦的生活经历也影响了他的写作，特别是他的第二部小说《No Longer at Ease》。
points.descriptionEn: Achebe pursued his postgraduate studies at the University of London's University College, where he continued his literary work. His time in London also influenced his writing, particularly his second novel, 'No Longer at Ease.'

points.title: 文学活动与教学
points.description: 阿契贝在美国纽约生活了数十年，期间他继续写作并参与文学活动。他还担任了多个大学的教职，包括康奈尔大学和耶鲁大学。他的作品继续受到国际关注，并对后殖民文学产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Achebe lived in New York for several decades, where he continued to write and engage in literary activities. He also held teaching positions at several universities, including Cornell University and Yale University. His works continued to receive international attention and had a profound impact on postcolonial literature.

supporter.zh: 钦努阿·阿契贝被视为尼日利亚文学的重要人物，他的作品深刻揭示了非洲文化和殖民主义的冲突。他的精神遗产在于他对非洲文化的坚持和对文学艺术的贡献。
supporter.en: Chinua Achebe is regarded as an important figure in Nigerian literature, whose works profoundly reveal the conflict between African culture and colonialism. His legacy lies in his steadfast commitment to African culture and his contributions to literature and the arts.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为阿契贝的作品过于悲观，对殖民主义的描绘过于简单化。他们还指出，他的某些作品可能忽视了尼日利亚社会的复杂性。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Achebe's works are overly pessimistic and simplify the depiction of colonialism. They also point out that some of his works may overlook the complexities of Nigerian society.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，钦努阿·阿契贝被广泛认为是后殖民文学的代表人物之一。他的作品不仅对尼日利亚文学产生了深远影响，也对全球文学产生了重要影响。
objective.en: In the academic and popular cultural spheres, Chinua Achebe is widely regarded as one of the representatives of postcolonial literature. His works have had a profound impact not only on Nigerian literature but also on global literature.

self.zh: 文学是抵抗遗忘的武器。
self.en: Literature is a weapon against amnesia.

others.zh: 钦努阿·阿契贝是非洲文学的巨匠，他的作品将非洲的声音带到了世界。
others.en: Chinua Achebe is a master of African literature, and his works have brought the voice of Africa to the world.
